requirements.text: The Rokt Residency is an 18 week, full-time, paid early-career program for software engineers working out of our office in New York City .
The Rokt Residency is an 18 week, full-time, paid early-career program for software engineers working out of our office in New York City .

We are an AI-first company. We’re a team of builders. That means the person who spots the problem is usually the person who fixes it, and “someone should build a tool for that” is treated as a volunteer sign-up sheet. We use AI and automation tools to move faster, and expect you to figure things out when the path isn’t obvious. If you prefer established processes and clearly defined lanes, you probably won’t like it here.
